name: Werner-Boyce Salt Springs State Park

experience: Walk the Springs Trail past Salt Spring and several small artesian springs and sinks; time it for low tide to see the waterfall. Then rent a kayak and paddle the mangrove creeks out toward the Gulf. The state park lists dolphins in its waters, and you can paddle to Durney Key to swim.

name: Forest Road 33 (Orange Hammock Road, the old FR 65) roadside dispersed sites
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: A wide crushed-gravel forest road running north from SR 40 along the west edge of the Juniper Prairie Wilderness, with sandy pull-offs in sand pine scrub on the west side. The first usable pull-offs are within about a mile of the highway, which makes it roughly five minutes from Juniper Springs; Silver Glen and Salt Springs are further up SR 19. No toilets, water, tables or signal.
access: No reservation needed. Stay limit: 14 days in a 30-day period Ocala WMA general gun season is Nov 14, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027 in the Pipeline, Hopkins Prairie and Lake Delancy units (Church Lake Unit on the far west edge: Nov 14-22 and Nov 28 - Dec 6). FWC 2026-27 brochure: 'During the general gun season, camping is prohibited, except in designated campgrounds and Juniper Prairie Wilderness.' Forest Service: 'Camping is allowed only in designated campsites during general gun season.' So roadside dispersed camping here is NOT legal on any night of Nov 21 - Dec 8, 2026; it was legal in late October. Deer hunters must wear 500 sq in of fluorescent orange; wear orange yourself if you walk outside a campground.

conditions.summary: Dispersed camping is prohibited forest-wide during general gun season, Nov 14, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027. Legal again from Jan 11, 2027. Nearest legal sites for the trip: Hopkins Prairie Campground ($16) or Juniper Springs Campground ($38). (source dated read 2026-11-12)

camp.sedanNote: Forest Service road data lists FR 33 as crushed aggregate or gravel, maintenance level 3 'suitable for passenger cars', open all year for its full 11.1 miles; Florida Rambler drove it in a Honda Civic ('adequate, although I could hear sand scraping the bottom'). The numbered side spurs (33-1.4, 33-2.4, 33-3.8) are native sand rated high-clearance, so stay on the main road's pull-offs.
camp.carSleepingNote: FWC brochure: 'Camping is allowed throughout the year. Use of trailers or self-propelled camping vehicles is prohibited except in designated campgrounds.' Neither FWC nor the Forest Service says whether sleeping inside a passenger car counts.

FWC 2026-27 brochure: 'During the general gun season, camping is prohibited, except in designated campgrounds and Juniper Prairie Wilderness.' Forest Service: 'Camping is allowed only in designated campsites during general gun season.' So roadside dispersed camping here is NOT legal on any night of Nov 21 - Dec 8, 2026; it was legal in late October. Deer hunters must wear 500 sq in of fluorescent orange; wear orange yourself if you walk outside a campground.
